{{Short description|none}}
'''European Society for Mathematics and the Arts (ESMA)''' is a [[Europe]]an society to promoting [[mathematics]] and the arts.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.math-art.eu/Newsletters/newsletter12-10.pdf|title=EUROPEAN SOCIETY FOR MATHEMATICS AND ART NEWSLETTER |publisher=European Society for Mathematics and the Arts |date=December 2010 |access-date=March 30, 2015}}</ref> The first Conference of ESMA, took place in July 2010 at the [[Institute Henri Poincaré]] in Paris.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.euro-math-soc.eu/review/mathematics-and-modern-art|title=Review: Mathematics and Modern Art |publisher=[[European Mathematical Society]] |date=November 27, 2012 |access-date=March 30, 2015}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.austms.org.au/tiki-read_article.php?articleId=81|title="Mathematics and the Arts" Paris, 19–20 July 2010|publisher=[[Australian Mathematical Society]] |date=November 15, 2009 |access-date=July 14, 2015}}</ref>
